description: A dark, painterly parlour interior. A glossy black grand piano with its lid raised stands in the foreground, with an open music book on the stand and a small illegible gold-ish mark on the case near the keys. Beside it, tall French windows stand open onto a moonlit garden with a still pond reflecting a full moon. Damask wallpaper, a gilt mirror, drapes and a patterned rug complete the room. No people are visible.
